summary: A toggle for an on/off setting, with its label, description and error laid out beside it, taking part in forms.

label.note: Visible label next to the track and accessible name. Required: shadow DOM keeps an external <label for> from naming the inner input.

hideLabel.note: Visually hides the label; it stays the accessible name. Use only when the row has other visible text naming the setting.

description.note: Help text under the label, in the accessible description.

error.note: Error message. Setting it marks the field invalid and sets a customError validity (SB-0009).

value.note: Submitted with the form while on; nothing is submitted while off.

checked.note: On (true) or off (false). Not reflected: the attribute is the default that form reset restores.

size.note: Track and thumb size: default 32x20 with a 16px thumb, sm 24x16 with a 12px thumb. The label typography does not change.

required.note: Native required: must be on to submit (valueMissing while off). Adds an aria-hidden asterisk after the label.

disabled.note: Native disabled; dimmed; cannot be toggled; not submitted. A <fieldset disabled> ancestor disables it too without changing this attribute.

anatomy.name: field
anatomy.notes: Grid: track in the first column, label, description and error in the second.

anatomy.name: track
anatomy.notes: Pill-shaped track; fill shows the state. Holds the native input and the thumb.

anatomy.name: input
anatomy.notes: Native <input type="checkbox" role="switch"> covering the track, visually transparent; receives focus, Space, clicks and validation.

anatomy.name: thumb
anatomy.notes: Round knob; sits at the start when off and at the end when on (mirrored in RTL). Pointer events pass through to the input.

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.notes: Native <label for> in the same shadow root; clicking it toggles.

anatomy.name: error
anatomy.notes: Persistent polite live region; text appears when invalid.

input.note: Each user toggle. Native and composed, so it crosses the shadow boundary. Not fired when checked is set from code.

change.note: Toggle committed by the user. Re-dispatched from the host because native change is not composed (NativeControl). FormData read in a listener already has the new value.

focus-visible.note: 3px solid ring around the track (a translucent ring would fall under 3:1).

checked.note: Track fills with the primary color and the thumb moves to the end.

invalid.trigger: error set, or required and off after blur or a submit attempt

disabled.trigger: disabled attribute or a disabled fieldset ancestor (:host(:disabled))

accessibility.accessibleNameSource: The label prop, through a native <label for> in the same shadow root. An external <label for> activates the switch but does not name it.

formAssociation.note: FormAssociated + NativeControl mixins (ElementInternals): setFormValue(value) only while on, validity mirrored from the inner input (required -> valueMissing; error -> customError), formResetCallback restores the default checked attribute, formStateRestoreCallback restores on/off, disabled (own or fieldset) is not submitted, <label for> on the host is forwarded to the inner input.

accessibility.targetSize: Track is 32x20 (sm 24x16); the label next to it is part of the clickable row and the 12px gap satisfies the WCAG 2.5.8 spacing exception.
accessibility.focusRingVisible: On keyboard focus of the input; 3px solid ring in switch.focus-ring.color around the track.
accessibility.missingNameWarning: Dev-only console warning, once, when label is empty.

keyboard.Tab: move focus to and from the switch
keyboard.Enter: submits the form (implicit submission; the control has no form owner in its shadow root, SB-0009). Does not toggle.

aria: role="switch" on the native checkbox; its checked state is exposed as aria-checked true/false natively
aria-describedby -> description and error ids (same root)
required: native required; the asterisk is aria-hidden
error: sets a customError validity, so the form blocks submission
thumb is aria-hidden decoration; the state is not conveyed by color alone (thumb position)
announcements: on/off is announced by the screen reader from the native switch role on toggle
error text is announced once when it appears (persistent aria-live=polite region)

useCases.when: A setting that is either on or off, such as enabling notifications
useCases.use: sb-switch with a label naming the setting

useCases.when: The consequence of turning it on needs explaining
The setting must be turned on before the form can be submitted
useCases.use: required, with error for a custom message

antiPatterns.pattern: Picking several options from a list, or agreeing to terms
antiPatterns.why: A switch is an on/off setting; a checkbox records a choice (Checkbox contract usage)

antiPatterns.pattern: Choosing exactly one option from several
antiPatterns.why: A switch has only two states

antiPatterns.pattern: A label that changes with the state, like "On" / "Off"
antiPatterns.why: The switch role already announces on and off; the label names the setting (WAI-ARIA APG switch pattern)
antiPatterns.alternative: A fixed label that names the setting

antiPatterns.pattern: A toolbar button that stays pressed
antiPatterns.why: That is a pressed button, not a form setting

drift.contract: label, description and error are props of Switch
drift.realization: shadcn composes Field and Label around Switch; shadow DOM requires them inside
shadcn renders a <button role=switch> with a hidden input; native gives form behavior and Space for free (SB-0007)
shadcn uses bg-input (neutral-200), below 3:1; changed for WCAG 1.4.11

drift.contract: default track 32x20 with a 16px thumb and 2px inset (size.switch.*, space.switch.inset)
drift.realization: shadcn default track is 32x18.4 (h-[1.15rem]); rounded to the 4px grid

drift.contract: thumb uses color.background off and color.primary-foreground on, in every mode
drift.realization: shadcn switches the unchecked thumb to foreground in dark mode; one token per state keeps the layers one step (T2) and contrast is checked per mode (T6)
not reflected: the attribute is the default restored by form reset

openQuestions.question: Contract content drafted with the contract-author skill (visual reference, WAI-ARIA APG)?
openQuestions.answer: Yes: the visual reference's Switch (look, sizes default and sm), WAI-ARIA APG switch pattern (role, keyboard), and the form-associated-controls rule.

openQuestions.question: Native <input type=checkbox role=switch>, or a <button role=switch> like the visual reference?
openQuestions.answer: Recommended and chosen: the native checkbox with role=switch (the reference's button is recorded as drift), through FormAssociated + NativeControl. It gives Space, validity, label activation and the checked state natively (SB-0007).

openQuestions.question: Is checked reflected to an attribute?
openQuestions.answer: Recommended and chosen: no, as Checkbox. The attribute is the default that form reset restores.

openQuestions.question: Does Enter toggle the switch (optional in the APG) or submit the form?
openQuestions.answer: Recommended and chosen: Enter submits the form (implicit submission, SB-0009), as Checkbox and the native control do; only Space toggles.

openQuestions.question: Which sizes, and does size change the label?
openQuestions.answer: Recommended and chosen: default and sm, the reference's two (aliased to medium and small in spec/api.json). Size changes only the track and thumb; label, description and error keep their typography.

openQuestions.question: Where does the label sit: after the track, or before it with the track at the end of the row?
openQuestions.answer: Recommended and chosen: after the track, the same grid as Checkbox. A settings row with the switch at the end is composed with Field or Item, not a prop (YAGNI).

openQuestions.question: What does required mean for a switch?
openQuestions.answer: Recommended and chosen: it must be on to submit (native valueMissing while off), as a required checkbox.

openQuestions.question: Does the thumb animate under prefers-reduced-motion?
openQuestions.answer: Recommended and chosen: no. The thumb moves without a transition when the person prefers reduced motion.
